biography.plain_text: Patrick H. Thomas is an American financial technology executive who led Atlanta-based First Financial Management Corporation. A Georgia State University graduate, he began in banking and rose from assistant treasurer to chairman. His career centred on building a major publicly traded transaction-processing company, which merged with First Data in 1995.

long_biography.plain_text:
Buying small companies gave Patrick Thomas a way to reach customers who were difficult to win individually. At First Financial Management, acquired businesses retained their locations, managers and working cultures. Former owners received stock arrangements that encouraged them to stay, while sales and marketing remained decentralised.

The company also examined why banks struggled to make money from processing merchants' credit card receipts. Installing electronic terminals at cash registers reduced the costly handling of paper. Its acquisition of NaBanco helped turn that practical change into a substantial processing operation. The purchase of TeleCheck added cheque verification, extending the company's services beyond card transactions.
